armour:diamond_boots:

blocks:log_oak:

Run 3: warmer and even finer than run 2; furthest from today's deep vertical ridges.
blocks:leaves_oak:
Runs 1 and 2: greyscale as asked, but darker than today's (mean grey 140 and 131 against 174), so the tint comes out a deep green; leaves smaller and noisier, about the same gaps (17-19% clear).
Run 3: as run 2, dark and fine.
armour:verdict: All three runs keep our palette, outline and light, but my 'scales sewn on a backing' prompt turns the plates into fine scales that read as noise at 2x. The 03 sheet (runs 2 and 3) brought back the front-view boots. Guides 3 changes nothing for armour: run 3 is a reroll of run 2. None keeps 11-04's big faceted plates: to match it, ask for 3-5 large crystal plates per piece, not scales.
tools:verdict: Built tools: every run reproduces today's look closely (sword and pickaxe almost the same); the haft comes out a brighter orange than the game's oak ramp. Guides 3 changed nothing here (run 3 rerolls run 2), and the reroll shows the hoe is the unstable design: right in run 2, wrong in runs 1 and 3. Loose parts are new (today's are grey generics): all runs give clean diamond parts that match the drawn heads; the hoe blade is too small in all three.
food:verdict: Food reproduces today's set almost exactly in all three runs (bread, apple, raw beef, carrot). The drift: cooked beef browner and duller, the egg warmer. The sheets (runs 2 and 3) match today's sizes better than run 1; run 3 (a reroll of run 2) has the best trout and cooked beef.
blocks:verdict: The guide's sheets bring the ore and stone closer to today's tiles. The log gets noisier and finer with them, and every run makes leaves darker and finer than today's. Guides 3 changed none of these families, so run 3 is a reroll of run 2.
guides3:diamond: Run 2: a cut brilliant, a jewel rather than our shard cluster. Run 3: 'a cluster of small cubes', as Guides 3's gem form says. Both leave our approved shard cluster: Guides 3's form note overrides our key here.
guides3:iron_ingot: Run 2: a lumpy rounded bar, off. Run 3: a stamped bar on the diagonal with lit top, mid side and dark end, very close to today's ingot. Guides 3 fixed the ingot.
guides3:coal: Run 2: a glossy black heap. Run 3: a matte grey heap ('fuel is matte, never glossy'), against our lesson that coal is glossy black-brown with blue-grey glints; today's is glossy. Both failed the outline check, as coal does (the guide expects it).
guides3:wheat_seeds: Both: a few big golden grains scattered apart, as our lesson asks and Guides 3's seed note says; today's is a pale heap. Run 3's grains are bigger and read better.
guides3:grass_top: Both: fine noise, no leafy tufts, so it reads flatter than today's tufted top. Run 3 is no different from run 2.
guides3:grass_side: Both: dirt clods with a thin fringe (about 3-4 px); today's fringe is a quarter of the tile with long drips. Guides 3 asks for the quarter-height fringe, but run 3's is only slightly deeper.
guides3:verdict: Guides 3 matters where it adds a family note: the ingot came out right, the seeds better. But the gem form turned our diamond into cubes, and 'fuel is matte' made coal grey, both against our approved items and lessons. Before merging: say in the item guide's lessons that our approved diamond (a shard cluster) and coal (glossy) win over the family notes, or drop those two notes.
